Output: (a) Interpretation Lock FIRST (one bullet per source line): - Line <ID> <copy exact source line> => Locked Meaning (truth-conditions) - If comparative/degree: define entities A,B, relation (>,<,≈), and degree (e.g., "slightly"). - Note: A>B is equivalent to B<A; do not reverse the ordering. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 64 Quando vidi costui nel gran diserto, 65 «Miserere di me», gridai a lui, 66 «qual che tu sii, od ombra od omo certo!». Reference Translation (provided): When I saw him in the great desert, “Have pity on me!” I cried to him, “whatso thou art, or shade or real man.”

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST**
- **Line 64** `Quando vidi costui nel gran diserto,` → **Locked Meaning**: There exists a past moment *t* such that at *t* the speaker (*I*) visually perceived (*saw*) the individual denoted by the demonstrative pronoun *costui* (≈ “him”) while that individual was located inside the spatial region described as *the great desert*.
- **Line 65** `«Miserere di me», gridai a lui,` → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker performed the speech act of crying out (*gridai*) to the addressee (*him*), uttering the imperative clause *Miserere di me* (“have pity on me”), thereby requesting the addressee’s mercy directed toward the speaker (*me*).
- **Line 66** `«qual che tu sii, od ombra od omo certo!»` → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker addresses the addressee with a disjunctive identification: “whatever you may be, whether shade or certainly a man,” asserting that the addressee’s ontological status is one of the two alternatives (shade ∨ real man).
*No comparative or degree expressions are present, so no A‑B relation is defined.*
